recognize_zh: 低倍胃切片中，致密深藍色的淋巴細胞浸潤由固有層下方一路延伸到黏膜下層，將胃腺體推擠、分開並取代深部黏膜，這種在胃黏膜形成大片淋巴組織的表現是胃 MALT 淋巴瘤的低倍線索。
features: Dense, diffuse sheet of small basophilic lymphoid cells expanding the deep lamina propria and submucosa
Gastric glands in the superficial mucosa are separated, compressed and focally replaced by the infiltrate
Infiltrate extends toward the muscularis and adjacent fat at the lower right
Lymphoepithelial lesions and cytologic detail are not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of gastric wall shows a dense, diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and submucosa. The infiltrate separates and replaces the deeper gastric glands while the surface epithelium is relatively preserved, and it extends toward the deeper wall. Lymphoepithelial lesions and cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. The pattern is suggestive of extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT (gastric MALT lymphoma), to be confirmed by higher-power evaluation, immunohistochemistry and H. pylori assessment.

ddx.dx: Chronic H. pylori gastritis with lymphoid follicles
ddx.vs: Reactive gastritis shows discrete follicles with a mixed plasma cell infiltrate confined to the superficial mucosa, without destructive sheets or lymphoepithelial lesions and without light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the stomach
ddx.vs: DLBCL consists of sheets of large transformed cells with high proliferation rather than small marginal zone cells.
MCL is composed of monotonous small cleaved cells that are cyclin D1 and CD5 positive.
